sections.heading: Iron Law — steps
lines: The user's exact words are the insight. Never paraphrase. Never clean
up. The vivid, unpolished, stream-of-consciousness phrasing captures
something that cleaned-up prose does not. Preserve it in block quotes

sections.heading: Iron Law — steps 2
lines: use judgment to follow the Iron Law — steps 2 guidance:
The Analysis section can interpret; the transcript section is sacred

sections.heading: Iron Law — steps 3
lines: ✅ `"The ambition-to-lifespan ratio has never been more fucked"`
❌ `User noted the tension between ambition and mortality`

sections.heading: When to invoke
lines: The user sends an audio or voice message via any channel (Telegram, voice
memo upload, openclaw audio attachment). The host agent typically provides
the transcript text. If not, transcribe via `gbrain transcription` (Groq
Whisper by default; OpenAI fallback for audio > 25MB segmented via ffmpeg)

sections.heading: Decision tree (where the content goes)
lines: Apply in order. First match wins. If multiple categories apply, file to
the primary directory and cross-link to the others
**Original idea, observation, or thesis** — the user is expressing a
novel thought, framework, or connection THEY generated
**About a world concept they encountered** — a framework or model
someone else created that the user is referencing
**About a specific person** — new information, opinion, or observation
about someone
**About a specific company** — new info about a company
**A product or business idea** — something that could be built
**A personal reflection** — therapy-adjacent, emotional, identity
**Multiple categories?** Create the primary page, then cross-link to all
others. If the voice note covers a person AND a novel idea, create the
originals/ page AND update the person's timeline

sections.heading: Naming convention
lines: Audio files: `YYYY-MM-DD-<brief-slug>.<ext>` (e.g.,
`2026-04-13-rick-rubin-creative-philosophy.ogg`)
Brain pages: match the slug of the destination directory

sections.heading: Bulk vs. single
lines: This skill handles ONE voice note at a time. Each is its own ingest cycle

sections.heading: Bulk vs. single — steps
lines: No batching

sections.heading: Anti-Patterns
lines: ❌ **Paraphrasing the transcript.** The exact words are the signal
❌ **Cleaning up hesitations or filler words** ("um", "like", "you
know"). The texture matters.
❌ **Creating a page with no entity cross-links** when people/companies
were mentioned. Iron Law fail

sections.heading: Anti-Patterns — steps
lines: ❌ Skipping the audio storage step. Always upload the original; the brain page has a `🔊 [Audio]` link back to it
